topic: Why Your Dishwasher Smells and How to Clean It
notes: Keep the guide model-agnostic and tell readers to consult their dishwasher manual before removing filters or using a cleaner. Food debris, clogged/dirty filters and drainage issues can contribute to odors. Clean removable filters with running water and a soft brush when the model permits it, reinstall them securely, and do not operate a dishwasher without required filters. Do not mix cleaners. If vinegar is mentioned, present it only as a manufacturer-dependent option, not a universal rule.
